entities.summary: William Douglas Pawley was a U.S. ambassador and noted businessman who was associated with the Flying Tigers American Volunteer Group (AVG) during World War II. William D. Pawley was a performers & entertainers from Florence (1896-09-07, Florence–1977-01-07). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to economic history and geopolitics.
